title: Design content expansion coverage
coverage: Twenty of the fifty visible design nominees now have multi-artifact research profiles. Thirty remain roster-only. This is a selected public-source study, not a ranking or complete study of every nominee.
method: Read original essays, official case studies and project documentation, or original interviews. Prefer authors' syndication to unrelated summaries. Preserve unknown publication dates; project year is not a publication date. Interpretive tradeoffs, self-reported outcomes, team authorship, mutable documentation, and untested demos are labeled.
supersedes: The aggregate counts in design-coverage.json describe the initial fourteen-profile batch. This addendum supplies the expanded twenty-profile counts without modifying those original research files.
